title: ECS Task Credential Theft Chain
description: ECS tasks receive IAM credentials via the task role, which are available inside the container through the metadata endpoint or environment variables. An attacker with code execution in a container (e.g., via a vulnerable application) can retrieve these credentials. If the task role has sts:AssumeRole or iam:CreateAccessKey, the attacker uses the stolen credentials to assume higher-privilege roles or create persistent access keys, escalating from the task's permissions to broader account access.

steps.context: Extract task role credentials from container
